his words.the registered rule the authority: The registered rule must remain the authority for comparison semantics. Before duplicating the comparison in production code, establish how conformance to the registered bytes is tested. The implementation must not quietly become the definition of what counts as a match.

keeping.held by: the scene in the route's answer, and declared in the record of an admission relying on that still
keeping.kept on 1381b31: computed by 1381b31's own expression read from its code (its routes' parse_qs without keep_blank_values and Gateway.still's and Gateway.preview_still's fullmatch), an observation of the base and never the rule; it parts from the rule on K12 and K15, where a blank first value (scene=, or a bare scene) is dropped and the second value kept
keeping.rule: v0 evidence.still.declared: the first value of the scene query parameter, kept as it is when it is exactly 64 characters, each 0-9 or a-f, else ""; a query parameter as application/x-www-form-urlencoded defines it: the query's parts split on '&', each a name and a value split at its first '=' (a name with no '=' has the empty value), '+' a space and percent escapes decoded in both the name and the value (OPEN-1, OPEN-2, OPEN-7: read from v0's text). Applied to POST /studio/preview/still as well: v0 keeps a preview's still 'by the still's rule', read as the whole of evidence.still.declared's keeping (spec v2 §3(a)). An implementation conforms when it keeps what every vector keeps; no library call is the rule
